mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a declining nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the last two months signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both UNRATE increased and PAYEMS decreased over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and related economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the last three months signals a disinflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real income and purchasing power increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to be robust.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average.
